questions.markdown: You are tasked with designing a digital circuit for a security monitoring system that checks the status of a 4-bit sensor array, where each bit (A3, A2, A1, A0) represents a sensor's status (0 = inactive, 1 = active). The circuit should count the number of active sensors (1's in the input) and output this count in binary. Develop an ASM chart and control circuit to represent the operation of this circuit.

Design a three-bit up/down counter using D flip-flops in Verilog. It should include a control input called Up/Down. If Up/Down = 0, then the circuit should behave as an up-counter. If Up/Down = 1, then the circuit should behave as a down-counter.
Brief Ring counter and write Verilog code that represents an eight-bit ring counter.
Design a Bit-Counting circuit to count the number of bits in a register, that has the value 1. Draw and explain the Datapath circuit and control circuit for the same.
Realize synchronous 3-bit gray code up-counter using T-flipflops with an appropriate sequence diagram, excitation table, and logic diagram.
Design a MOD-6 ripple counter using a T-flipflops and explain its working using a timing diagram.
